blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of exploring everything there is to see in Tanzania. Epic Tanzania safari adventures to find Africa’s Big Five, the climb up Kilimanjaro, relaxing days on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: it is all here in Tanzania. And there is good news, because Your Tanzania Trip can design a custom made itinerary to fit all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: Looking for ideas? Our most popular itineraries can inspire you. A lot of our clients choose to finish their exciting safari with several days of rest on one of the most stunning beaches of Zanzibar. Would you enjoy that too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: We are ready to help, whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather have a journey made to measure. Step on board and prepare to discover Tanzania at your own pace, in exactly the way you like!

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: On arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, you are welcomed by our Your Tanzania Trip guide, who is already waiting. He brings you to your hotel so you can recover from the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Before your climb: Ahead of the climb you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on what to pack, what to wear and other useful tips that will help make your climb as comfortable as possible.

blocks.orig: The first morning, your guide picks you up from the hotel and takes you to Machame Gate. The first part leads you through coffee and banana plantations, as well as an untouched and very green rainforest. After a five to six-hour hike, you reach the Machame Camp on the edge of the forest area with a heather zone. This is your first day at this altitude, so remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: On the first morning your guide collects you from the hotel and drives you to Machame Gate. The trail starts among coffee and banana plantations and then passes through a lush, untouched rainforest. A hike of five to six hours brings you to Machame Camp, at the edge of the forest where the heather zone begins. It is your first day at this altitude, so make sure to drink lots of water!

blocks.orig: This second day on the mountain starts with another nice climb that is a little steeper. You first pass to a small circular cliff known as the picnic rock where you are rewarded with stunning views of Kibo (a peak of Kilimanjaro) and Shira (one of the other volcanic peaks). From the picnic rock, you hike on to Shira Camp via a beautiful route to have lunch and rest. If you wish, you can take an acclimatisation walk towards the Lava Tower (to an altitude of 4630 meters and a distance of 2 km).
blocks.html: Your second day on the mountain begins with another pleasant climb, slightly steeper this time. First you reach a small round cliff called the picnic rock, where you are treated to wonderful views of Kibo (one of Kilimanjaro's peaks) and Shira (another of the volcanic peaks). From the picnic rock a lovely route leads on to Shira Camp, where you have lunch and rest. If you like, you can do an acclimatisation walk towards the Lava Tower (up to an altitude of 4630 meters, over a distance of 2 km).

blocks.orig: From Shira Camp to the beautiful Lava Tower, you go through many ascents and descents with amazing views along the way. You have lunch at Lava Tower for one to two hours for your body to acclimatize as you might feel uncomfortable with the increase in altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp. Watch out for strange-looking flowering plants that grow up to five meters high! Barranco Camp is located at the foot of the imposing Barranco Wall, which is impressive in both its sheer size and steepness.
blocks.html: The walk from Shira Camp to the beautiful Lava Tower takes you up and down many times, with superb views on the way. At Lava Tower you have lunch for one to two hours, so your body can acclimatise, as the higher altitude may make you feel unwell. After lunch you go down to Barranco Camp. Keep an eye out for odd-looking flowering plants that can reach five meters in height! Barranco Camp lies at the base of the imposing Barranco Wall, which impresses with both its enormous size and its steepness.

blocks.orig: After breakfast, you depart Barranco Camp and hike towards Barranco Wall. After a challenging but enjoyable route, you reach the top of the Barranco wall and have a spectacular view of the Kibo volcano to your left and of the distant Mount Meru to your right. Then a more difficult hike starts through Karanga Camp, with many ascents and descents, after which you reach your camp for the night: Barafu Camp, the last camp before the summit! Enjoy a hot meal and make sure to relax and sleep, before your final ascent to the summit!
blocks.html: After breakfast you leave Barranco Camp and walk towards the Barranco Wall. Following a demanding but fun route, you arrive at the top of the Barranco wall, with a magnificent view of the Kibo volcano on your left and Mount Meru far away on your right. Next comes a harder hike via Karanga Camp, with lots of climbs and descents, until you arrive at your camp for the night: Barafu Camp, the final camp before the summit! Have a hot meal and be sure to rest and sleep before the last climb to the summit!

blocks.orig: Today is the day! Around midnight you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a small time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: The big day has come! At around midnight you leave Barafu Camp for Uhuru Peak. The trails are good, and the hardest part is the high altitude. At the summit you can watch a beautiful sunrise, which is very impressive at this height! You spend a short time at the top celebrating your great achievement, then slowly make your way down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millenium camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast you take an easy walk to the park exit.
blocks.html: The Millenium camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Waking up today, you feel relief thanks to the lower altitude and pride at having reached the summit. After breakfast there is an easy walk to the park exit.

blocks.orig: Your driver then brings you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest!
blocks.html: From there your driver takes you back to the hotel for a well-earned rest!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Sadly your holiday has come to an end, and it is time to head home. Enjoy the last hours of your stay in Tanzania until our driver picks you up and drives you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Not had enough yet? You are welcome to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
